# Studio Starter

> Studio Starter is a starter site built on Astro + Sanity. It serves as a neutral template for building content-managed websites with Astro, Sanity CMS, and Cloudflare Workers. Replace this description with your own business details.

## Key pages
- [Services and pricing](https://example.com/services/): Every service tier and what it costs
- [Process](https://example.com/process/): How a project works from first call to final reveal
- [Portfolio](https://example.com/portfolio/): Recent projects
- [E-Design](https://example.com/e-design/): Online offering delivered digitally, for clients anywhere
- [About](https://example.com/about/): The studio's story and philosophy
- [FAQ](https://example.com/faq/): Common questions about working together
- [Contact](https://example.com/contact/): How to book a consultation
- [Gift certificates](https://example.com/gift-certificates/): Give the studio's help as a gift

## Tools and resources
- [Style quiz](https://example.com/quiz/): A short quiz that suggests a direction
- [Budget calculator](https://example.com/calculator/): A rough budget range for a project
- [Free guides](https://example.com/guides/): Downloadable guides
- [Resources](https://example.com/resources/): Tools and recommendations
- [Journal](https://example.com/journal/): Articles and project notes
- [Shop my favorites](https://example.com/shop/): Recommended pieces and sources
- [Press](https://example.com/press/): Where the studio has been featured
